phases.milestone: Explain how vaccines prompt immune responses and prepare the body for later exposure.
phases.title: How vaccination builds protection

skills.description: Identify pathogens as microbes that can cause illness and trigger an immune response.
skills.name: Identify pathogens that trigger immune responses

skills.description: Explain how the immune system uses recognizable features of a pathogen, called antigens, to target it.
skills.name: Explain how immune cells recognize antigens

skills.description: Describe how early immune defenses detect a threat and alert other immune cells.
skills.name: Explain how innate defenses raise an alert

skills.description: Explain how certain immune cells display antigens so other immune cells can respond to a specific threat.
skills.name: Explain how immune cells present antigens

skills.description: Explain how helper T cells coordinate a targeted immune response after recognizing a presented antigen.
skills.name: Explain how helper T cells coordinate defenses

skills.description: Describe how B cells respond to a matching antigen and receive help to produce antibodies.
skills.name: Explain how B cells become activated

skills.description: Explain how antibodies bind to a pathogen and can help stop it from causing illness.
skills.name: Explain how antibodies help prevent illness

skills.description: Explain how killer T cells recognize and destroy infected cells.
skills.name: Explain how killer T cells respond

skills.description: Explain how some B and T cells remain after an immune response and respond faster to a familiar threat.
skills.name: Explain how immune memory develops

skills.description: Explain how a vaccine exposes the immune system to an antigen or instructions for making one without requiring the disease itself.
skills.name: Explain how vaccines train immune defenses

skills.description: Compare broad ways vaccines supply an antigen or instructions for making one.
skills.name: Compare ways vaccines present antigens

skills.description: Explain how additional doses can strengthen or renew an immune response.
skills.name: Explain why booster doses can help

skills.description: Explain why changes to a pathogen can make existing immune recognition less effective.
skills.name: Explain how variants affect immune recognition

skills.description: Explain why vaccination can reduce the chance of illness without preventing every infection.
skills.name: Explain why vaccinated people can get infected

skills.description: Explain how immune activation can cause short-lived symptoms after vaccination.
skills.name: Explain common reactions after vaccination
